heading: So your clients arrive <highlight>without asking.</highlight>
description: Your booking page shows the address, an embedded map, and a direct link to Google Maps or Waze — no more “where is it, exactly?”.

features.title: Exact address, always visible
features.description: Neighborhood, city, and landmark exactly as it appears on Google Maps.

features.title: "Get directions" button
features.description: One tap opens the route in Google Maps or Waze right from the client's phone.

features.title: Easy to share
features.description: Share the link on WhatsApp, Instagram, or Google Business — clients show up without asking.
